learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn the traffic signals of grammar that tell us when to stop, pause, or ask a question!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like a green light means GO, a Capital letter tells us a sentence is starting! We also use capital letters for special names of people, places, and the pronoun I.
A full stop is a red light. It tells the sentence to STOP at the end. But, if a sentence is asking something, we use a curly question mark instead!
A comma is like a yellow light. It tells you to slow down and take a tiny breath. We use it to separate things in a list, like: I bought apples, bananas, and grapes.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Traffic Light Reading!
fun_activity.instructions: Read a page of your favorite storybook out loud. Whenever you see a comma, say 'slow down'. Whenever you see a full stop, shout 'STOP!'

quick_recap: ⭐ Every sentence starts with a Capital letter.
⭐ Telling sentences end with a Full Stop.
⭐ Asking sentences end with a Question Mark.
⭐ Commas help us pause and separate items in a list.
